content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Karen Alexander (E030)
Requested: write access to Source Code
Role: Analyst
Employment type: contractor
Security training: basic

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Karen is a contractor with basic security training. So maximum is read. Requested write is above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Source Code system is owned by Engineer role. Karen is Analyst, so even if full time, admin wouldn't apply. But she's contractor anyway.

Decision: read.
